task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

excluded_cohorts: From Published Evidence to Analyzable Biomedical Cohorts

model.name: transported_joint_bp_scenario_v1
model.interpretation: An assumed equal-weight representation of the declared peso_lab-weighted complete-case analytical population, not a nationally representative or target-validated reconstruction.

age.law: For integer k from lower through upper, P(age=k) is proportional to u_k^(kernel_alpha-1)*(1-u_k)^(kernel_beta-1), where u_k=(k-lower+0.5)/(upper-lower+1).

bmi.law: Lognormal conditional on age and female, conditioned on the stated BMI bounds.

bp.law: Bivariate Gaussian innovations added to the specified means, jointly conditioned on the BP support while holding each person's covariates fixed.
bp.estimand_warning: The nominal BMI mean terms and Gaussian innovation correlation are not asserted to equal the requested OLS coefficients and residual correlation after the omitted age hinge and conditional support restriction.
